findings.title: Bind execution evidence to the flow revision actually run
findings.trigger: Regenerate or modify a same-name flow while leaving its prior successful studio-flow.json in place.
findings.actual: The finalizer accepts execution.ok and matching flow name, then records the current flow SHA. The execution report contains neither executed-flow SHA nor manifest SHA, so it can accept stale execution evidence for a new flow revision. It also omits results[0].ok.
findings.recommendation: At successful execution, record SHA256 of the exact flow payload executed plus manifest SHA; finalizer must compare those to current files and require successful inner execution. Use a fail-before-run or immutable payload to avoid a generation/run race.

proof.method: Pure in-memory perturbation; no files or actual flow execution changed.

findings.title: Describe aggregate evidence at its actual scope
findings.actual: The row says native-roundtrip.json records exact authored bounds/pivots. Actual final report keys are status, placements, meshParts, triangles, sha256, authoredRoot, layoutStep, bankWidth, scope; no bounds/pivot assertion results are recorded there.
findings.recommendation: State the report proves isolated aggregate reload/counts/hash, and cite separate verified bounds/pivot evidence if applicable; alternatively record and gate actual bounds/pivot checks.
